2609.21743.title: Balanced Prompt Adaptation against Entropy-Induced Collapse for Test-Time Binary Segmentation
2609.21743.paper_summary: Entropy minimization is a standard objective for test-time adaptation (TTA), but it can fail in imbalanced binary segmentation. Unlike image classification, dense segmentation aggregates thousands of pixel predictions, allowing the larger predicted class to dominate the update, pull minority predictions toward itself, and produce a degenerate mask as predictions saturate and their entropy gradients vanish. We theoretically establish this collapse in a shared-shift model. This analysis motivates Balanced-Anchor Prompt Adaptation (BAPA), which combines two complementary modules. The Class-Balanced Anchors (CBA) module selects high-confidence anchors separately from each predicted class and gives foreground and background equal total loss weight, preventing the larger region from dominating the update. Dynamic Prompt Adaptation (DPA) refreshes these anchors after each prediction update and optimizes only text-side prompt residuals while keeping the vision-language encoders frozen. This prompt-only update refines the foreground-background decision boundary without altering the pretrained dense visual representation. Across experiments from four domains, BAPA achieves the highest mean Dice among the evaluated methods. Factorized ablations further validate the complementary roles of CBA and DPA, supporting balanced prompt adaptation as an effective alternative to entropy minimization for test-time binary segmentation.
2609.21743.paper_summary_zh: 熵最小化是測試時適應（TTA）的標準目標，但在不平衡的二元分割中可能會失敗。與圖像分類不同，密集分割聚合了數千個像素預測，允許較大的預測類別主導更新，將少數預測拉向自己，並在預測飽和且其熵梯度消失時產生退化的掩碼。我們在共享偏移模型中理論上建立了這種崩潰。這一分析促進了平衡錨點提示適應（BAPA）的提出，它結合了兩個互補模塊。類別平衡錨點（CBA）模塊分別從每個預測類別中選擇高置信度的錨點，並給前景和背景相等的總損失權重，防止較大區域主導更新。動態提示適應（DPA）在每次預測更新後刷新這些錨點，並僅優化文本側的提示殘差，同時保持視覺-語言編碼器凍結。這種僅提示的更新在不改變預訓練的密集視覺表示的情況下，細化了前景-背景的決策邊界。在來自四個領域的實驗中，BAPA在評估的方法中實現了最高的平均Dice。分解的消融進一步驗證了CBA和DPA的互補角色，支持平衡提示適應作為測試時二元分割中熵最小化的有效替代方案。
